Series RC circuit: the emf phasor is the vector sum of V_R and V_C; the current leads the emf

Animation of a series RC phasor diagram. Phasor diagram for a resistor and capacitor in series with an AC source, built in stages. First the red current phasor appears at 45 degrees. Then the blue resistor-voltage phasor, twice as long and in phase with the current, and the green capacitor-voltage phasor, as long as the current phasor and lagging it by 90 degrees. Then the black emf phasor, the vector sum of the two voltages, at angle omega t from the x axis; the current leads it by phi. Finally all phasors rotate together and their projections are traced against time on the right: four sine waves for one period, then only the current and the emf, with the current peaking before the emf.
